title: World history
learning_outcomes: Explain historical chronology in the context of world history.
Compare and distinguish primary and secondary sources in the context of world history.
Apply trade and migration in the context of world history.
Evaluate and justify decisions about competing interpretations in the context of world history.

lessons.title: Historical chronology
lessons.outcome: Explain historical chronology in the context of world history.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving historical chronology; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to comparative timeline.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain historical chronology from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of historical chronology; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Primary and secondary sources
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish primary and secondary sources in the context of world history.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving primary and secondary sources; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to comparative timeline.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain primary and secondary sources from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of primary and secondary sources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Trade and migration
lessons.outcome: Apply trade and migration in the context of world history.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving trade and migration; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to comparative timeline.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain trade and migration from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of trade and migration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Competing interpretations
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about competing interpretations in the context of world history.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving competing interpretations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to comparative timeline.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain competing interpretations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of competing interpretations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of historical chronology; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of primary and secondary sources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of trade and migration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of competing interpretations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
